Never publish them or commit them to a public repo. Room 3 (second bedroom, 3.52 x 2.98 m inside: x 3.584..7.110, y 3.642..6.619). x, y = footprint centre in plan metres (x right, y up); rot_deg = world rotation.y = plan angle CCW; the model's front (+z in the GLB) faces plan angle rot_deg - 90. dims_mm = from the product page (w x d x h). A piece with "parent" sits in that piece's local frame: "local" = [x, bottom height, z] in metres (glTF axes: x across, z = front direction = foot of the bed), rot_deg relative to the parent. "kind": "bedding" is drawn parametrically (duvet + 2 pillows sized from dims_mm, colours from "colors").
